scope.note: the widest ring inside the passable component: the boundary of the largest enclosed hole

algorithm.name: widest enclosed-hole ring
algorithm.metric: the largest Chebyshev distance t for which the passable component still encloses a hole; the ring is that hole's boundary

clearance.metric: the ring is the hole boundary of the region D >= t, so every station is at least t + erosion cells from blocked cells
clearance.bandTierReason: 1.680 m is the documented maximum car width with no safety margin
